description: Search bedbathandbeyond.com by keyword or browse a home-goods department.

brandContains.description: Keep only products whose detected brand or title contains this text (case-insensitive), e.g. `Superior`, `SAFAVIEH`, `KitchenAid`.
brandContains.title: Brand contains

category.description: Browse one of the site's home-goods departments. Implemented via the site's own search relevance for the department name (see README — the direct category-browse pages are blocked by the site's bot protection).
category.title: Department / category (mode=byCategory)

fastShippingOnly.description: Only emit products eligible for two-day delivery.
fastShippingOnly.title: Two-day shipping only

keywords.description: Free-text search query, e.g. `towel`, `comforter set`, `kitchen island`.
keywords.title: Search keywords (mode=search)

maxPrice.description: Drop products priced above this amount.
maxPrice.title: Maximum price (USD)

minPrice.description: Drop products priced below this amount.
minPrice.title: Minimum price (USD)

minRating.description: Drop products with an average rating below this (1-5 stars).
minRating.title: Minimum customer rating

onSaleOnly.description: Only emit products currently marked on sale.
onSaleOnly.title: On-sale products only

sortBy.description: How results are ordered. Applied client-side to the fetched relevance-ranked result window (see README) since the upstream site's own sort control is a client-side-only feature not reproducible via a plain HTTP request.
sortBy.title: Sort order

title: Bed Bath & Beyond Scraper Input
